# FreeBSD 14.5-RELEASE amd64 libc, regcomp()/regexec() under LC_CTYPE=C.UTF-8, as lsof calls them (REG_NOSUB, REG_EXTENDED unless b, REG_ICASE for i).
# The format of posix_regex_glibc.txt: H and the commands in hex (glibc's 62, 10 more, and 44 for REG_ICASE and the escapes), then a line a
# case: expression (hex), flags, and the answer: a 0 or 1 for each command, or ! and regerror()'s text. glibc's 1,500 expressions, then 665 of
# FreeBSD's grammar, then 543 for REG_ICASE (every ASCII letter, letters and classes past ASCII, ranges, back-references) and for a backslash
# before a character past ASCII (DIVERGENCES 183).
# Made in the VM by differential/freebsd-regex.c from these expressions (2026-11-21).
